rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for the maple tree itself.

example.english: That maple turns red in autumn.
example.traditional: 公園入面嗰棵楓樹秋天會變紅。
example.jyutping: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 go2 fo2 fung1 syu6 cau1 tin1 wui5 bin3 hung4

rows.note: Use this for the characteristic flavor of maple syrup or maple-flavored food.

example.english: These cookies have a nice maple flavor.
example.traditional: 呢包曲奇有陣楓糖味，好香。
example.jyutping: ni1 baau1 kuk1 kei4 jau5 zan6 fung1 tong4 mei6 hou2 hoeng1

rows.note: Use this when referring to maple wood as a material or type of timber.

example.english: This dining table is made of maple wood and feels really solid.
example.traditional: 張餐枱用楓木整，摸落好實淨。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 caan1 toi2 jung6 fung1 muk6 zing2 mo1 lok6 hou2 sat6 zing6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the light-brown color associated with maple wood, especially in product or design descriptions.

example.english: I want the shoe cabinet in a maple color.
example.traditional: 我想要楓木色嗰款鞋櫃。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 fung1 muk6 sik1 go2 fun2 haai4 gwai6
